name: Default Content Tools
description: Suppress Default Content import, or delete content that the Default Content API / recipes already imported.

suggests.drupal/default_content: Enhances functionality by providing additional default content export/import.
suggests.drupal/recipe_tracker: Enables the RecipeTrackerCatchup pass so recipes applied before this module was installed can still be cleaned up, and adds a per-recipe-log delete operation.

project_description: Default Content Tools adds two operator controls on top of Drupal core's Default Content API and recipe system. First, it can globally suppress the import of all default content (a PreImportEvent subscriber skips every discovered item by UUID when the suppress_import flag is on). Second, it can delete content that has already been imported: a confirm form reachable from the module list and from Reports > Recipes deletes the shipped content of a chosen module or Composer package by loading each entity by UUID and deleting it, and a RecipeAppliedEvent subscriber automatically deletes a recipe's content once that recipe finishes applying when the recipe's machine name is listed in delete_recipes. Two config actions (markRecipeContentForDeletion / unmarkRecipeContentForDeletion) let a composing recipe additively opt another recipe's content into or out of that automatic deletion without clobbering entries added by other recipe layers. When the recipe_tracker module is also installed, a catch-up subscriber sweeps the persisted recipe log so content can be deleted even when the recipe that requested the deletion was applied after the recipe that provided the content.
